text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with BTC showing slightly steeper losses than ETH, suggesting selective pressure on the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index at 27 indicates sustained fearful sentiment with no improvement over the week, while Bitcoin dominance has edged up to 56.2%, pointing to capital rotating toward the safest major asset during uncertainty. Volume remains healthy at $61B, though the declines across most altcoins alongside modest BTC/ETH weakness signal a general risk-off environment rather than panic liquidation.
